ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between a large central high-intensity (tan/white) region and low-intensity (black) peripheral boundaries and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located contiguous high-intensity (tan/white) region occupying roughly 75% of the surface area; bounded by low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edges and lower peduncle insertion; multiple low-intensity vertical linear blobs distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular topography with high-amplitude valleys (slits) concentrated on the right lobe trailing edge; low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve trajectory extending from the medial notch to the lateral distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white/gray) concentrated at the lateral tips of both lobes; smaller isolated circular high-contrast marks on the right lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the lower half of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep vertical structural incisions (slits) along the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle encrustations on the distal lateral edges of both tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive tan-hue pixel distribution across the high-intensity central regions, indicating non-pigment surface accumulation.
